item.title: Meal - Arayes
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef or lamb mince
  • 1 onion, grated and drained
  • 1 jalapeño, grated
  • 4 garlic cloves, grated
  • ¼ cup parsley, chopped
  • 1 tsp baharat
  • ½ tsp each cumin, paprika, salt and black pepper
  • 4 pita breads, halved
  • Olive oil

Directions

  1. Mix the mince with onion, jalapeño, garlic, parsley and spices.
  2. Spread a thin, even layer of filling inside each pita half.
  3. Brush the outside lightly with olive oil.
  4. Grill or pan-fry over medium heat for 4–5 minutes per side, then cook the open meat edge until the filling is cooked through.
  5. Serve hot with yoghurt or tahini sauce.

References

  • Original Instagram post — unavailable during extraction; recipe reconstructed from matching arayes references.

item.title: Meal - Beef Bulgogi Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g steak, very thinly sliced
  • 1 onion, grated
  • 1 Asian pear, grated
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • ¼ cup brown sugar
  • 1 tsp sesame oil
  • 2 garlic cloves, grated
  • 2cm ginger, grated
  • 2 tbsp gochujang
  • 1 tbsp sesame seeds
  • 4 large burrito wraps
  • Cooked rice
  • Kimchi
  • Sliced spring onion
  • Kewpie mayonnaise

Directions

  1. Mix beef with onion, pear, soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, gochujang and sesame seeds.
  2. Marinate for at least 2 hours.
  3. Stir-fry the beef in batches over high heat for 2–3 minutes.
  4. Layer rice, kimchi, beef, mayonnaise and spring onion on each wrap.
  5. Roll tightly and toast in a dry pan or sandwich press.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Beef Taco Rice Bowl
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Ground beef - 500g
  • Rice - 2 cups cooked
  • Corn - 1/2 cup

  • Cheese - 1/2 cup

item.title: Meal - Big Mac Toastie
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Bread slices - 4
  • Ground beef - 300g
  • Cheese - 4 slices
  • Pickles - to taste
  • Onion - 1/4 (finely diced)
  • Lettuce - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Butter - 1 tbsp

Big Mac Sauce

  • Mayonnaise - 3 tbsp
  • Ketchup - 1 tbsp
  • Mustard - 1 tsp
  • Pickle juice - 1 tsp
  • Paprika - pinch

Directions

  1. Cook ground beef in a pan, breaking it up and seasoning with salt and pepper
  2. Mix all Big Mac sauce ingredients in a small bowl
  3. Butter the outside of the bread slices
  4. On the inside, layer beef, cheese, pickles, onion, lettuce and sauce
  5. Close sandwich and cook in a pan or sandwich press until golden and crispy
  6. Slice and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 680
  • Protein - 38g
  • Carbs - 42g
  • Fat - 38g

Notes

  • Corrected from previous misclassification (was incorrectly labelled as a chicken wrap)
  • Classic fast-food style toastie — high calorie, high fat

item.title: Meal - Cheeseburger Bowls
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Ground beef - 500g
  • Potatoes (or fries) - 400g
  • Cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Pickles - to taste
  • Lettuce - 1–2 cups (shredded)
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)

Burger Sauce

  • Mayonnaise - 3 tbsp
  • Ketchup - 1 tbsp
  • Mustard - 1 tsp
  • Pickle juice - 1 tsp

Directions

  1. Cook potatoes or fries until crispy
  2. Cook ground beef with salt and pepper until browned
  3. Mix burger sauce ingredients in a bowl
  4. Assemble bowls with potatoes, beef, cheese, lettuce, onion, and pickles
  5. Drizzle with burger sauce and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 40g
  • Carbs - 35g
  • Fat - 22g

Notes

  • Identified as cheeseburger-style bowl based on user verification
  • Typical “burger in a bowl” structure (beef + potato base + sauce)

item.title: Meal - Chili Mac and Cheese
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Olive oil - 1 tbsp
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Onion - 1 (finely chopped)
  • Red bell pepper - 1 (chopped)
  • Lean ground beef - 500g
  • Diced tomatoes - 1 can
  • Pasta or macaroni - 250g
  • Cheese - 1 cup shredded
  • Stock or water - as needed
  • Seasoning
    • Chilli powder
    • Cumin
    • Paprika
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot and cook the garlic, onion and red bell pepper until softened
  2. Add the ground beef and cook until browned
  3. Stir through the chilli powder, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper
  4. Add the diced tomatoes and pasta
  5. Pour in enough stock or water to cook the pasta and simmer until tender
  6. Stir through the shredded cheese until melted
  7. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 510 per serving
  • Protein - 30g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 20g

Notes

  • The reel title was not fully visible from public snippets, but the ingredient pattern matches a chili mac and cheese style dish

item.title: Meal - Grilled Cheese Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef mince
  • Taco seasoning
  • 1 cup cooked seasoned rice
  • 1 cup grated cheddar, plus extra for grilling
  • 1 cup queso or nacho cheese sauce
  • ¼ cup chipotle sauce
  • 1 cup sour cream
  • Crushed tortilla strips
  • 8 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Brown the beef, add taco seasoning and cook until the sauce has reduced.
  2. Layer beef, rice, queso, cheddar, chipotle sauce, sour cream and tortilla strips on each wrap.
  3. Roll tightly into burritos.
  4. Scatter cheese in a hot non-stick pan and place each burrito seam-side down over it.
  5. Turn once the cheese forms a golden crust and toast the other side.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - High Protein Grilled Cheese Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 900g extra-lean beef mince
  • ½ white onion, diced
  • 4 garlic cloves, minced
  • Taco seasoning
  • 400g canned diced tomatoes
  • 250ml chicken stock
  • 100g light cheddar
  • 600g cooked rice
  • Coriander
  • 6 large tortillas
  • 1 tbsp nacho cheese sauce per burrito
  • 20g light mozzarella per burrito

Directions

  1. Brown onion, garlic and beef, then add taco seasoning, tomatoes and stock.
  2. Simmer until the mixture is thick, then stir through cheddar and coriander.
  3. Divide rice, beef filling and nacho cheese sauce between tortillas and roll tightly.
  4. Place mozzarella in a hot non-stick pan and set the burrito on top.
  5. Cook until the cheese forms a crust, then turn and toast the other side.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - High Protein Mexican Bowl
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Rice - 200g (uncooked, portioned ~50g per serve)
  • Extra lean beef mince - 500g
  • Tinned tomatoes - 400g
  • Taco seasoning - 1 packet (or ~20g)
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (optional)
  • Onion - 1 (optional)
  • Oil spray (minimal)

Optional Add-ons

  • Greek yogurt (as sour cream substitute)
  • Lettuce
  • Cheese (light)
  • Salsa or hot sauce

Directions

  1. Cook rice according to packet instructions and set aside
  2. In a pan, cook onion and garlic until softened (optional)
  3. Add lean beef mince and cook until browned
  4. Stir in taco seasoning and tinned tomatoes
  5. Simmer until thickened and well combined
  6. Portion rice into containers or bowls
  7. Top with beef mixture and optional extras
  8. Serve or store for meal prep

Macros

  • Calories - 480
  • Protein - 44g
  • Carbs - 59g
  • Fat - 9g

Notes

  • Macros confirmed from reel caption :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
  • Designed as a high-protein, low-fat meal prep option
  • Very scalable and easy to batch cook

item.title: Meal - Nacho Beef Folded Wrap
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef mince
  • 1 packet taco seasoning
  • ¼ cup water
  • 4 large tortilla wraps
  • 1½ cups grated cheddar
  • 1 cup crushed nacho chips
  • 1 cup shredded lettuce
  • ½ cup diced tomatoes
  • ½ cup sour cream
  • 1 tbsp olive oil or butter

Directions

  1. Brown the beef, drain excess fat, then add taco seasoning and water and simmer until thick.
  2. Warm the tortillas and cut one slit from the centre to the edge.
  3. Divide cheese, beef, crushed chips, lettuce, tomato and sour cream between the four tortilla quarters.
  4. Fold each quarter over the next to make a layered triangle.
  5. Toast in oil or butter for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.

References

  • Original Instagram post — no longer available; recipe matched by title and listed ingredients.

item.title: Meal - Nacho Cheese Beef Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1kg lean beef mince
  • 1 red onion, diced
  • 1 green capsicum, diced
  • 1 red capsicum, diced
  • 1 packet taco seasoning
  • 130g low-sugar ketchup
  • 150ml water
  • 230ml light evaporated milk
  • 180g Mexican cheese blend
  • 30ml hot sauce
  • 6 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Brown the beef with onion and capsicum.
  2. Add taco seasoning, ketchup and water, then simmer until thick.
  3. Warm evaporated milk gently, add cheese and hot sauce, and stir until smooth.
  4. Divide beef and cheese sauce between tortillas.
  5. Roll into burritos and toast seam-side down.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Smashed Potato Cheeseburger Bowls

item.title: Meal - Spicy Steak & Cheese Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 16 low-carb wraps
  • 900g lean steak
  • Reduced-fat cheese
  • 800g cooked rice
  • Salt and black pepper
  • Paprika, garlic powder and cumin
  • Coriander
  • Onion and capsicum

Sauce

  • 300g fat-free Greek yoghurt
  • 70g light sour cream
  • 50g chipotle in adobo
  • Juice of ½ lime

Directions

  1. Season and cook the steak, then slice or chop it.
  2. Sauté the onion and capsicum until tender.
  3. Blend or stir together the yoghurt, sour cream, chipotle and lime.
  4. Divide rice, steak, vegetables, cheese and sauce between wraps.
  5. Roll tightly and toast, or wrap and freeze for meal prep.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe
